prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game card illustration, full-bleed portrait 2:3, high-resolution PNG. No Chinese/East Asian fantasy, palace roofs, cloud-scroll ornament, calligraphy, jade pendants or eastern dragons. No blown-out whites or particle noise.
